entities.summary: Masjid Temenggong Daeng Ibrahim formerly known as the State of Johor Mosque, is a mosque located in Telok Blangah, Singapore. Adjacent to the VivoCity shopping centre, the present day mosque was built in 1993 as a reconstruction of an 1845 structure. It is named after Daeng Ibrahim bin Abdul Rahman, the fourth Temenggong of Johor, during whose reign the original mosque was completed.
